title: Auto-block
intro: Source IPs that failed too many logins or scanned the box are blocked here for a while. Detector thresholds and the allow-list live in Config → Security; the allow-list (and loopback) is never blocked.
empty: No sources are blocked right now.
allowlistHint: To stop a source from ever being blocked, add it to the allow-list in Config → Security. Unblocking here is temporary — a source that keeps offending is blocked again.

dialog.title: Block a source by hand
dialog.help: Enter an IP address to block for an hour. A source on the allow-list cannot be blocked.
